answer_1.quote: Vision tasks include VQAv2 , GQA (Hudson and Manning, 2019), TextVQA , VizWiz , ScienceQA , POPE , and OK-VQA . Audio tasks cover TUT , VocalSound , and Clotho . Video tasks include MSRVTT  and MSVD , and point tasks focus on ModelNet40  and Objaverse .
